description: Reads the tiles of a tile layer, optionally only a sub-rectangle. Outputs raw GID values including flip bits (0 = empty cell). If the output is truncated, that is stated visibly.

height.description: Height of the region. Default: to the bottom edge.

layer.description: Name of the layer; inside groups also 'group/layer'. Alternatively use layer_id.

layer_id.description: Id of the layer. Unique, unlike the name. Alternatively use layer.

max_cells.description: Upper limit of cells in the output. Default 2048.

path.description: Path to ONE Tiled map file (.tmx or .tmj) — no directory, no wildcards. Please pass it absolute: a relative path is resolved against the working directory of the server process, and that is chosen by the MCP host, not by the project.

width.description: Width of the region. Default: to the right edge.

with_flags.description: true shows 'index[HVD]' instead of the raw value. Default: false.

x.description: Left edge of the region in tiles. Default 0.

y.description: Top edge of the region in tiles. Default 0.

name: read_layer
title: Read layer contents
